subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the chubby fluffy catfish-like creature whose appearance is defined by <Picture 1> (the first uploaded image): a round egg-shaped body covered in short soft grey-brown fur with darker spots, a large cream-colored fluffy belly, several long pale catfish barbels hanging from its muzzle, two tiny curved antennae on top of its head, very large bulging white eyes with small dark pupils, two tiny buck teeth, small flipper-like arms, short legs, and a small fish tail.
<Subject 2> is the chubby fluffy round creature whose appearance is defined by <Picture 2> (the second uploaded image): a spherical warm-brown body with a cream-colored belly and muzzle, short plush fur, three curved dark-brown hair tufts on top of its head, no whiskers and no tail, small stubby three-fingered arms, short feet with tiny toes, heavy drooping eyelids, and a small downturned mouth with two tiny teeth.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a single-shot, vertically framed 3D animated rant. <Subject 2> stands face-to-face with <Subject 1>, jabs one stubby finger directly at <Subject 1>'s nose, and in a fierce, indignant voice delivers an accusation about a powerful brand that deletes review videos and could just as easily delete customers' suffering. <Subject 1> flinches and looks guilty while the camera slowly pushes in. Both turnaround-sheet images guide character identity only, not framing.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the spotted grey-brown fur, cream belly, long catfish barbels, twin antennae, bulging eyes, buck teeth, flipper arms, and fish tail from <Picture 1> are all retained.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the warm-brown spherical body, cream belly and muzzle, three curved head tufts, stubby arms, drooping eyelids, and downturned mouth from <Picture 2> are retained; the reference image's neutral grumpy expression is intensified into shouting anger.

detailed_description:
The target video is a high-quality 3D plush-animation style with soft diffused studio lighting, a seamless warm-grey backdrop matching the reference sheets, and shallow depth of field.
[Shot 1] A medium two-shot opens with <Subject 1>, the spotted catfish creature, standing on the right side of the frame, and <Subject 2>, the brown round creature, on the left, both shown full-body. <Subject 2> leans aggressively forward, tilts its chin up, and thrusts its right stubby arm straight out so its short fingertip stops just in front of <Subject 1>'s round nose between the long barbels. Its drooping eyelids narrow, its three head tufts quiver, and its small downturned mouth opens wide as it shouts in a gruff, fiery, righteous voice (S1) that comically contrasts its cute plush body, delivering the line in fast angry bursts with two brief bitter pauses. From 00:00.0 to 00:03.5 it barks, <d>[Chinese] 一个可以轻松全网删掉测评视频的</d>, stabbing the finger forward once on each key phrase. At 00:03.5 it curls its lip with heavy sarcasm, narrows its eyes to slits, and sneers through 00:05.3, <d>[Chinese] “名族品牌”，</d>, jabbing the fingertip so close it nearly touches the catfish's nose. From 00:05.3 to 00:09.5 its voice drops lower and slower, trembling with suppressed rage, as it says, <d>[Chinese] 同样可以在你死在车里、坏在路上之后，</d>, leaning in step by step with two sharp forward jabs on “死在车里” and “坏在路上”. From 00:09.5 to 00:11.6 it suddenly raises its voice to a biting climax, shouting, <d>[Chinese] 轻松删掉你的遭遇！</d>, and delivers one final hard finger jab on the last word. Throughout, <Subject 1> recoils backward, its big bulging eyes growing even wider, its barbels drooping, its buck teeth biting its lower lip; it swallows hard and shrinks its round body as if guilty, with small nervous ripples running through its fluffy belly. The camera performs a slow, steady push-in from the medium two-shot to a tighter chest-up framing of both faces, with a barely perceptible handheld shake that intensifies during the climax, and holds on <Subject 2>'s furious pointing pose and <Subject 1>'s frightened face through the final frame at 00:12.0.

overall_soundscape:
Near-silent studio room tone with a faint airy hum. The dominant sound is <Subject 2>'s sharp gravelly shouting voice (S1), close-mic'd and clear; soft plush rustling accompanies each arm jab and <Subject 1>'s nervous flinch, followed by a tiny audible gulp from <Subject 1>.

non_diegetic_music:
A subtle tense underscore lies under the voice: a low sustained string drone with sparse muffled drum pulses, slow and restrained, swelling only slightly during the final climax and cutting sharply with the last finger jab, so the spoken line stays dominant.
